CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.vw_users_detail AS
SELECT
    u."Id"             AS "UserId",
    u."FullName",
    u."Email",
    u."Role",
    u."HotelId",
    h."Name"           AS "HotelName",
    h."Code"           AS "HotelCode",

    u."UpdatedAt"

LEFT JOIN public."Departments" d ON d."Id" = u."DepartmentId";
